LL.Settings.RegistryMenuHint: Open the Drug Registry editor to define Drug Categories of substances. Consumable items with 'drug' trait inherit Drug Category rules.
LL.Settings.PromptEmbraceHint: If On, every consumption opens a dialog asking the player whether to Resist (roll Fortitude normally) or Embrace (worsen the result by one degree).
LL.Settings.GhostPenaltyHint: Permanent penalty added to the Will DC of future addiction saves once a character has cured a Stage 1+ addiction in a category.
LL.Settings.LongRestRestoresToleranceHin: If On, taking a Long Rest refills the Tolerance.
LL.Settings.LongRestClearsToxicityHint: If On, taking a Long Rest drops Toxicity to 0.
LL.Settings.ShowSceneControlButtonHint: Adds a Logan's Loophole flask icon to the Token Controls menu on the left side of the screen for quick GM access to the Registry.
LL.Settings.UseConToleranceHint: Actors gain a baseline Tolerance equal to their Con. mod.
LL.Settings.ConToleranceAddictedOnlyHint: If enabled, the Constitution bonus to Tolerance only applies once the actor reaches Addiction Stage 1.
LL.Settings.TreatmentImmunityHoursHint: Immunity duration applied after a successful treatment (in hours)
LL.Settings.SeparateAddictionImmunitiesH: If enabled, Immunities are tracked individually for each substance. If disabled, treating an aspect (e.g. Hangover) grants immunity to that aspect across ALL addictions.
LL.Settings.TreatmentKitRequirementHint: Require the medic to have an Addiction Treatment Kit in their inventory to use the Treat Addiction action. Infinite-use Kit is an Equipment, and Expendable Kit is a Consumable.
LL.Settings.SoundSettingsMenuHint: Configure default SFX played for addiction lifecycle events. Each drug can override these individually.
LL.HUD.ToleranceTip: Absorbs Toxicity. Equals to your Constitution mod. and might be increased with Addiction progression.
LL.HUD.ToxicityTip: Intoxication stage. You progress your Intoxication stage when your Toxicity reaches the stage thresholds defined in the Registry. Toxicity decays over time and you sober up as it decays. When you reach a certain Toxicity threshold, you suffer the effects of that stage, might get hangover and might even overdose.
LL.HUD.AddictionTip: The tracker of your Addiction progress. You get Addiction Points (AP) when you fail Will saves triggered by consuming drug. When your AP reaches the stage thresholds defined in the Registry, you progress your Addiction stage. While addicted, you might suffer the effects of your current stage Permanent effects and might get withdrawal if your addiction isn't satiated.
LL.HUD.OverdoseTip: Locks further consumption of the drug.
LL.HUD.SatiatedTip: Addiction cravings are quiet, but your AP decay might be paused after the Satiation passes for the amount of days equal to this stage AP decay rate.
LL.HUD.WithdrawalTip: Cravings are active and you suffer Withdrawal effects, but your AP naturally decays.
LL.HUD.QuitPenaltyTip: Lingering DC increase to future Addiction saves vs. this drug: +{penalty}
LL.HUD.Unbound: The drug item is not bound
LL.HUD.StaleState: This actor has stale state for a category that no longer exists in the Registry. Click below to clean up.
LL.HUD.NoAddictions: This character has no addictions tracked yet.

LL.ItemSheet.ExposureMethodTip: Sets the item trait for how this drug is administered.
LL.ItemSheet.TVTip: How much Toxicity this dose yields. The amount is increased by 50% on a Critical Failure (rounded down)
LL.ItemSheet.FortDCTip: DC of the Fortitude save rolled when consuming this item. Leave blank for Level-Based DC.
LL.ItemSheet.DamageTip: Applied immediately when Toxicity breaches Tolerance.
LL.ItemSheet.PotentTip: Successful Fortitude saves are treated one degree worse.
LL.ItemSheet.AddictiveTip: When enabled, consumption triggers a Will save and feeds the addiction track.
LL.ItemSheet.APYieldTip: The amount of AP gained on the Will save triggered by consuming this drug.
LL.ItemSheet.NoCategoryWarn: This item is not bound to any drug category.
LL.Summary.TVTip: How much Toxicity this dose yields. The amount is increased by 50% on a Critical Failure (rounded down).
LL.Summary.PotentTip: Successful Fortitude saves are treated one degree worse.
LL.Summary.NonAddictiveTip: This substance intoxicates but triggers no Will save and does not feed the addiction track.
LL.Summary.IntoxicationStagesTip: You progress your Intoxication stage when your Toxicity reaches the stage thresholds defined in the Registry. Toxicity decays over time and you sober up as it decays. When you reach a certain Toxicity threshold, you suffer the effects of that stage, might get hangover and might even overdose.
LL.Summary.OverdoseTip: If Toxicity reaches the threshold, overdose fires. You must roll a Fortitude save against the DC and suffer the consequences.
LL.Summary.HangoverTip: If Toxicity rises above certain threshold, a Hangover queues up. When Toxicity decays back to zero, or after a Long Rest, you must roll Fortitude against Hangover effects.
LL.Summary.AddictionTip: Addictive consumption triggers a Will save. Critical Success yields {cs} AP. Success yields {s} AP. Failure yields {f} AP. Critical Failure yields {cf} AP. Crossing each stage's AP threshold escalates the addiction. AP decays naturally between doses; reaching 0 cures it, but may leave a permanent quit penalty.

LL.Registry.Title: Drug Registry
LL.Registry.OverdoseHelp: Triggered when TX reaches the threshold. Prevents further consumption until duration expires.
LL.Registry.APThresholdTip: AP required to reach this stage.
LL.Registry.MaxToleranceTip: Absorbs Toxicity. Equals to your Constitution mod. and might be increased with Addiction progression.
LL.Registry.WillPenaltyTip: Increases the DC of Addiction saves while at this stage (e.g. 4 makes saves harder by 4).
LL.Registry.QuitPenaltyTip: Lingering DC increase to future Addiction saves vs. this drug, even after fully curing.
LL.Registry.APDecayAmountTip: AP naturally decays while in withdrawal.
LL.Registry.SatiationTip: How long a dose pauses withdrawal.
LL.Registry.RootRollOptionsTip: Comma-separated. Applied to all saves and damage rolls within this category. Item traits and the category's slugified name are injected automatically.
LL.Registry.IntoxRollOptionsTip: Comma-separated. Added to Intoxication saves and damage rolls.
LL.Registry.IntoxStagesTip: You progress your Intoxication stage when your Toxicity reaches the stage thresholds defined in the Registry. Toxicity decays over time and you sober up as it decays. When you reach a certain Toxicity threshold, you suffer the effects of that stage, might get hangover and might even overdose.
LL.Registry.StageNameTip: A name for this intoxication stage.
LL.Registry.TVThresholdTip: Toxicity must be at least this value to enter this Intoxication stage.
LL.Registry.OverdoseRollOptionsTip: Comma-separated. Added to Overdose saves and damage rolls.
LL.Registry.FortitudeDCTip: DC for the Fortitude save triggered upon overdose.
LL.Registry.OverdoseEffectsTip: Applied immediately and sustained for overdose duration.
LL.Registry.EnabledTip: Turn off to disable hangovers for this category.
LL.Registry.HangoverNoEffect: A Critical Success or Success results in no hangover.
LL.Registry.HangoverEffectsTip: Applied and sustained for hangover duration.
LL.Registry.AddictionRollOptionsTip: Comma-separated. Added to Addiction Will saves.
LL.Registry.AddictionStagesTip: Stages 1+ represent escalating addiction. Stage 0 = clean. You get Addiction Points (AP) when you fail Will saves triggered by consuming drug. When your AP reaches the stage thresholds defined in the Registry, you progress your Addiction stage. While addicted, you might suffer the effects of your current stage Permanent effects and might get withdrawal if your addiction isn't satiated.
LL.Registry.AddictionStageNameTip: A name for this addiction stage.
LL.Effects.SustainedTip: Effects applied while the actor remains at this stage.
LL.Effects.ChronicTip: Chronic effects active while the actor is at this addiction stage.
LL.SFX.Help: Configure default SFX played at addiction lifecycle events.
LL.SFX.ConsumeTip: Played at the moment of consumption.
LL.SFX.IntoxicationTip: Played when the actor enters a new intoxication stage.
LL.SFX.AddictionTip: Played when the actor's addiction stage increases.
LL.SFX.SatiationTip: Played when a dose refreshes satiation (the addiction is temporarily quiet).
LL.SFX.WithdrawalTip: Played when an actor's satiation expires and they enter withdrawal.
LL.SFX.CureTip: Played when an actor recovers from a stage of addiction.
